title: GESTALT (RADS wave tables into PUMP, an SP-303 style compressor)
author: Robbie (SETTINGS row adapted from digihealth by irpina)
description: GESTALT for the Digitakt mk1, a mash-up of PUMP and RADS, in place of the stock compressor: RADS, Geiger Counter-style wave table destruction in stereo, into PUMP, an SP-303 Vinyl Sim-style levelling compressor, on everything the Digitakt plays. It takes the compressor's page among the master pages (FUNC+LFO), its eight parameters for its settings (kept with each pattern's kit, saved with the project, following SETTINGS > GLOBAL FX/MIX's global compressor), and its time in the render. A = TABLE: OFF, then one of GESTALT's own 512 wave tables (32 families of 16: 00-FF musical, 00.-FF. broken), crossfading as it turns; B = DRIVE into the 8-bit converter, -12 to +51.5 dB; C = SRR, 200 Hz to 48 kHz (OFF); D = BLEND, RADS's dry/wet; E = COMP: OFF, then threshold, ratio and make-up together; F = RATIO: AUTO, 2:1, 3:1, 4:1, 8:1, 10:1, 20:1, LIMIT; G = REL: PUMP through GLUE to LEVEL; H = OUT: the chain's level, -32 to +6 dB. The page: the wave table's curve, bouncing with the output, the eight controls with units and a gain-reduction meter; YES cycles the big curve and the gain-reduction graph. Press and turn for big steps; FUNC + turn snaps; FUNC + REC / STOP / PLAY copies, pastes, clears. SETTINGS > GLOBAL FX/MIX > FX ANIMATION stills the page. On core 4.1's master output and master pages, so it is on every output: main outs, headphones and USB.
